text:
📈 盤前心理學｜帳上一檔股票小賺，另一檔還套著。今天只能賣一檔，你的手會先伸向哪一檔？

有篇研究用台灣的真實交易紀錄看了這件事。研究者分析台灣證交所截至1999年的五年間「全部」交易：超過十億筆、近四百萬名投資人，而且知道每筆是誰下的。

研究發現，整體來看，投資人持股賺錢時賣出的機率，大約是賠錢時的兩倍。這種「賣賺錢的比賣賠錢的快」的傾向，學界稱為「處分效應」。在當時，84%的台灣投資人都呈現這個模式。

分群來看更有意思：個人、公司法人、自營商都不太願意實現虧損。投信和外資則沒有這種傾向，不過兩者加起來只佔不到5%的交易金額。

要提醒的是，這是二十多年前的資料，描述的是當時的行為模式。它沒有說哪種做法比較好，也不能直接套用到今天的市場。但下次想賣股票時，或許可以留意一下，自己是不是也有這個傾向 🤔

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 系列第一篇，用台灣自己的完整交易紀錄和兩個好記的數字（兩倍、84%）開場最貼近讀者，而且是真實行為資料，不是預測模型；要註明這是1990年代後期的資料。

paper.title: Is the Aggregate Investor Reluctant to Realise Losses? Evidence from Taiwan
paper.abstract: We ask whether the typical investor and the aggregate investor exhibit a bias known as the disposition effect, the tendency to sell investments that are held for a profit at a faster rate than investments held for a loss. We analyse all trading activity on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TSE) for the five years ending in 1999. Using a dataset that contains all trades (over one billion) and the identity of every trader (nearly four million), we find that in aggregate, investors in Taiwan are about twice as likely to sell a stock if they are holding that stock for a gain rather than a loss. Eighty-four percent of all Taiwanese investors sell winners at a faster rate than losers. Individuals, corporations, and dealers are reluctant to realise losses, while mutual funds and foreigners, who together account for less than 5% of all trades (by value), are not.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜一次「讀入資料」要花多少電？

量子演算法常假設，把傳統資料讀進量子電腦幾乎免費。這篇論文改把它當成硬體耗能來算：以超導量子處理器上、12個位址量子位元的一次QRAM查詢為例，查詢保真度約0.969，動態能耗約3.51×10⁻⁴焦耳，平均動態功率約4.38瓦。

研究也發現，同樣的保真度目標下，操作點與冷凍機各級的衰減分配，可能讓平均功率差到兩倍以上。

要注意：這是模型計算，不是實測，而且假設相當樂觀（相干時間約1秒，約高出現有紀錄三個數量級；冷卻效率取理論上限；靜態功率設為零）。

論文做到的是把能耗納入評估；如果成真，可能讓低溫設備與量子硬體的設計多一個能耗與冷卻的視角。離實際產品還很遠。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 今天午間需要一篇前沿技術論文，這篇尚未用過，且能清楚分開「論文做到的」與「可能的產業影響」，也避免與昨天的台股交易行為文章重複。

paper.title: The energetic cost of loading classical data in quantum computers
paper.abstract: Quantum algorithms for machine learning, chemistry, and cryptanalysis often assume coherent access to classical data at negligible physical cost. We instead treat data loading as a hardware process and quantify the dynamic energetic cost of a quantum random access memory (QRAM) query on a superconducting processor. Using the metric-noise-resource framework, we relate query fidelity and power to gate duration, relative two-qubit drive strength, and the distribution of attenuation across a multi-stage refrigerator, while accounting for thermal photons and gate errors. We analyze the linear-depth multiplexer and the noise-resilient bucket-brigade architectures, adapting the latter to a native superconducting gate set and refining its fidelity analysis using the fully decomposed gate schedule. For a representative bucket-brigade QRAM query with a $12$-qubit address register we obtain a query fidelity of $0.969$. The query consumes $3.51\times10^{-4}\,\mathrm{J}$ of dynamic energy, corresponding to an average dynamic power of $4.38\,\mathrm{W}$ and a peak of $64.4\,\mathrm{W}$. Our optimization shows that, at fixed target fidelity, the operating point and attenuation profile can change the average power by a factor of two or more.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜如果手上有一個股市每一筆交易、每一張委託單的完整紀錄，會看到什麼？

研究者取得台灣證交所 1995 至 1999 年所有投資人的交易資料。當時個人投資者約占九成成交金額。

研究估計，個人投資者的整體投資組合，每年報酬被拉低約 3.8 個百分點（含交易虧損、手續費、交易稅與擇時損失）。另一個算法是，五年的總損失約 9,350 億新台幣，相當於當時 GDP 的 2.2%。研究發現，幾乎所有交易虧損都可追溯到「積極委託」，也就是用較搶的價格求快速成交。法人扣除手續費與稅後，每年多約 1.5 個百分點。

這是 1990 年代末台灣的歷史資料，描述的是整體平均，不是每一個人，也不是現在該怎麼做的建議。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: Taiwan's market-wide data is a strong fit for local readers and adds a fresh study and angle after yesterday's disposition-effect post, avoiding a repeat of the same paper and steering clear of today's stock-specific headlines.

paper.title: Just How Much Do Individual Investors Lose by Trading?
paper.abstract: Individual investor trading results in systematic and economically large losses. Using a complete trading history of all investors in Taiwan, we document that the aggregate portfolio of individuals suffers an annual performance penalty of 3.8 percentage points. Individual investor losses are equivalent to 2.2% of Taiwan's gross domestic product or 2.8% of the total personal income. Virtually all individual trading losses can be traced to their aggressive orders. In contrast, institutions enjoy an annual performance boost of 1.5 percentage points, and both the aggressive and passive trades of institutions are profitable.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜打開看盤軟體，上千檔股票，你會從哪一檔開始看？

Barber 與 Odean 在 2008 年發表的研究，檢驗並證實一個假說：個人投資者整體而言是「吸引注意的股票」的淨買方，例如上新聞的股票、成交量異常放大的股票，以及單日報酬極端的股票。

他們的解釋是搜尋問題：要買，得在成千上萬檔股票裡找；要賣，個人投資者通常只賣手上已有的股票，不用大海撈針。所以他們推測，許多人只會考慮買先吸引到自己注意的股票：注意力先決定選項範圍，偏好才在範圍內做選擇。

這是在描述注意力如何影響選擇，不是在說這類股票該買或不該買。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這幾天連續用台灣交易資料的處分效果與損失研究，今天換成美股資料的注意力偏誤，是全新的研究與角度，也避開近期重複。

paper.title: All That Glitters: The Effect of Attention and News on the Buying Behavior of Individual and Institutional Investors
paper.abstract: We test and confirm the hypothesis that individual investors are net buyers of attention-grabbing stocks, e.g., stocks in the news, stocks experiencing high abnormal trading volume, and stocks with extreme one-day returns. Attention-driven buying results from the difficulty that investors have searching the thousands of stocks they can potentially buy. Individual investors do not face the same search problem when selling because they tend to sell only stocks they already own. We hypothesize that many investors consider purchasing only stocks that have first caught their attention. Thus, preferences determine choices after attention has determined the choice set.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜輸入有一半是零，算得反而更慢？

這篇 FPGA 論文的作者就遇到：跳過零值後，他們原本的引擎在 50% 稀疏度時，整張影像比密集輸入慢了 2.7 倍。問題不在乘法，而在累加：部分和零散抵達，得一再讀出、改寫。

論文做到的是把累加改成「每個結果只寫一次」，並分到不會互相衝突的記憶體分塊。RTL 模擬中，稀疏度約 70% 以內，速度貼近前端上限（差距 0.5% 內）；50–80% 稀疏度下，比一種散射式累加設計快 1.10–1.26 倍。代價是記憶體用量比早期版本多（BRAM 81 對 69）。

如果成真，可能影響的是邊緣 AI 推論晶片在「用記憶體換速度」上的取捨。但這只是 LeNet-5 小網路、固定 3×3 資料流的設計成果，其中 conv2 層端到端只有密集版的 0.87 倍速，離商用還有距離。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 昨天的量子QRAM已用過硬體題，今天換成AI推論硬體的不同層面，且不重複用同一篇；其他候選多為純模型評測，缺少可對應產業的內容。

paper.title: SkipLane: Write-Once, Conflict-Free Accumulation for Zero-Skipping CNN Engines on FPGAs
paper.abstract: Skipping zero activations saves multiplications in CNN accelerators, but it complicates accumulation: the products in a compressed input window belong to different output columns and must be merged. In our earlier engine, this merging was done by read-modify-write (RMW) of a row buffer, which made sparse inputs slower than dense ones even at 87% sparsity. Existing designs either merge kernel rows through RMW or reduce bank conflicts with extra hardware, without eliminating them. SkipLane makes the entire accumulation path write-once. Each kernel row is processed in its own lane, which holds partial sums in three registers and retires up to three finished columns per cycle into memory banks that cannot conflict. Lanes and input channels are summed only at readout, so no partial sum is ever read back. Multipliers left idle by zero weights compute a second filter in the same pass. In RTL simulation, the engine stays within 0.5% of its frontend bound up to 70% sparsity and is 1.10-1.26$\times$ faster than an SCNN-style scatter accumulator with 18 banks and ideal RMW at 50-80% sparsity. Six engines meet 140 MHz on a PYNQ-Z2 using 21.1k LUTs and run LeNet-5 bit-exact on the board. For conv1, the engine needs 1.94$\times$ fewer cycles than a dense engine (1.26$\times$ faster end to end); for conv2, whose rows are only 13 pixels wide, it reaches 0.87$\times$ the dense speed.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜今年當沖賺最多的人，明年還會是贏家嗎？

研究者分析台灣 1992 至 2006 年的當沖交易者：先依某一年（y 年）的報酬排名，再追蹤他們在隔年（y+1 年）的表現。結果 y 年排名最前面的 500 名，隔年平均每天費前報酬 61.3 bps，扣費後 37.9 bps；y 年排名墊底的人，隔年費前 -11.5 bps，扣費後 -28.9 bps。

更關鍵的是，研究發現只有不到 1% 的當沖交易者，能可預測且穩定地賺到扣費後的正異常報酬。

這代表：在這份資料中，交易者之間的表現差異確實存在，但能持續做到的人極少。這不代表任何人該怎麼操作，也不能直接推論到其他時期或市場。🙂

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 這是還沒用過的台灣真實交易資料研究，與近三天的處分效果、虧損、注意力偏誤都不同角度；同時避開今天以單一公司和執行長新聞為主的頭條，不硬掛新聞。

paper.title: The cross-section of speculator skill: Evidence from day trading
paper.abstract: We document economically large cross-sectional differences in the before- and after-fee returns earned by speculative traders by analyzing day traders in Taiwan from 1992 to 2006. We sort day traders based on their returns in year y and analyze their performance in year y+1; the 500 top-ranked day traders go on to earn daily before-fee (after-fee) returns of 61.3 (37.9) bps per day; bottom-ranked day traders go on to earn daily before-fee (after-fee) returns of -11.5 (-28.9) bps per day. Less than 1% of the day trader population is able to predictably and reliably earn positive abnormal returns net of fees.

text:
📈 盤前心理學｜如果券商 App 當機，哪些股票的交易會少得最多？

一項美國研究用某手機券商的資料發現：高關注度的股票，交易減少得特別多。研究者認為，這款 App 的用戶比其他散戶更常「因為被注意到而交易」。

原因可能不只一個。一部分與用戶多為較沒經驗的投資人一致，但研究也指出，App 本身的獨特功能同樣有部分影響。

摘要還提到，這群用戶集中買進的股票，後續 20 天的平均異常報酬為 -4.7%。

這不代表用手機下單的人都如此，研究比較的是這款 App 用戶與其他散戶。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 目前股市系列都用台灣證交所 1990 年代資料，這篇是較新的美股券商資料，也避免連續重複同一篇研究，並延伸 11-12 的注意力主題但切入點是 App 設計。

paper.title: Attention-Induced Trading and Returns: Evidence from Robinhood Users
paper.abstract: We study the influence of financial innovation by fintech brokerages on individual investors' trading and stock prices. Using data from Robinhood, we find that Robinhood investors engage in more attention-induced trading than other retail investors. For example, Robinhood outages disproportionately reduce trading in high-attention stocks. While this evidence is consistent with Robinhood attracting relatively inexperienced investors, we show that it is also driven in part by the app's unique features. Consistent with models of attention-induced trading, intense buying by Robinhood users forecasts negative returns. Average 20-day abnormal returns are -4.7% for the top stocks purchased each day.

text:
🏭 產業前沿｜8萬顆AI加速器，每一顆都在自己的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）裡存一份一模一樣的模型權重，有必要嗎？

瑞典烏普薩拉大學團隊提議：權重是唯讀的，改由一台伺服器透過光纖持續廣播，加速器直接接收，不先存進本地記憶體。

論文做到的是建模評估：在8萬顆加速器的規模下，估計可省下約4.00–8.44 PB的HBM（39–82%）。在選定的權重切分方式下，解碼吞吐量為HBM基準系統的0.96–1.57倍，每個token的能耗低10–42%。但若把整個模型串流給每顆加速器，吞吐量只剩基準的0.25–0.47倍。

如果成真，可能改變AI伺服器對HBM的需求結構。不過這是架構分析與模型估算，不是做出來的系統，論文也把部分硬體成本留給未來研究。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 今天要選一篇還沒用過的前沿技術論文，記憶體與 AI 伺服器是關注股市的人常聽到的供應鏈環節，跟前兩天的量子與 FPGA 題材不同，也不涉及任何公司。

paper.title: Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference at datacenter scale is fundamentally bottlenecked by memory capacity and bandwidth limits. Because model weights are read-only and identical across instances, conventional architectures that replicate these parameters across the local DRAM of tens of thousands of accelerators incur massive capital expenditures, significant static power dissipation, and redundant memory-fetch energy. A recent proposal to use optical fiber loops as delay-line memory alleviates these issues, but its recirculating loop must hold the whole model: loop length grows with model size, slack is fixed when the ring is built, and the layouts that serve modern Mixture of Experts (MoE) models efficiently do not fit in it. We propose Optical Broadcast Memory (OBM), an open-ended hierarchical Tap-and-Amplify fiber architecture that generalizes and replaces the optical ring paradigm. A centralized memory server continuously broadcasts weights to distributed inference nodes that passively tap the data stream using receive-only co-packaged optics, delivering parameters directly to compute units without intermediate buffering. To overcome the limitations of continuous weight streaming, we use dynamically-sized slack to accommodate large and variable context lengths. We show how removing the restrictions of the optical ring allows OBM to efficiently serve MoE models. Evaluated at a datacenter scale of 80,000 accelerators, OBM eliminates petabytes of HBM while being competitive or better in throughput and energy per token than an HBM-based system.

text:
🌙 盤後研究室｜晚上想問一個小問題：你上次點開某檔股票的頁面，是因為原本就在研究它，還是因為它剛好一直出現在眼前？

早上提過的券商 App 當機研究，用的是一款金融科技券商 App 的資料。研究發現，這款 App 的投資人比其他散戶有更多「受注意力驅動」的交易。當機時，高關注股票的交易減少得比較多。作者指出，這與平台吸引較缺乏經驗的投資人一致，但部分也和 App 的獨特功能有關。

摘要還提到，該平台用戶大量買進的股票，後續報酬為負：每天被買最多的那些股票，20 日平均異常報酬為 -4.7%。

這只是針對單一平台的研究，不代表任何人該怎麼操作。它更像一面鏡子：下單前，先問自己是被吸引，還是早有功課。

（研究分享，不是投資建議）
why: 今天早上用了這篇研究的當機發現，晚上用同一篇換成自我檢視角度，且避開今天以單一公司為主的新聞頭條；同時避免連續重複前幾天已用過的台灣交易資料研究。

paper.abstract: We study the influence of financial innovation by fintech brokerages on individual investors' trading and stock prices. Using data from Robinhood, we find that Robinhood investors engage in more attention-induced trading than other retail investors. For example, Robinhood outages disproportionately reduce trading in high-attention stocks. While this evidence is consistent with Robinhood attracting relatively inexperienced investors, we show that it is also driven in part by the app's unique features. Consistent with models of attention-induced trading, intense buying by Robinhood users forecasts negative returns. Average 20-day abnormal returns are -4.7% for the top stocks purchased each day.
